name: 10595 · Valhalla, NY
findings: ZIP 10595 (Valhalla) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10595 (Valhalla) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10595 (Valhalla) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
